rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a romantic or sexual lover, especially an affair partner.

example.english: I don't want people to know I have a lover.
example.traditional: 我唔想畀人知我有情人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 ngo5 jau5 cing4 jan4

rows.note: Use this for an established romantic partner or spouse when the relationship is framed as one's beloved rather than an affair.

example.english: After all these years, my wife is still my lover.
example.traditional: 咁多年，我太太仲係我嘅愛人。
example.jyutping: gam3 do1 nin4 ngo5 taai3 taai2 zung6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 oi3 jan4

rows.note: Use this more formal term for a romantic partner, especially in writing or careful speech.

example.english: This drama is about a lover who sacrifices himself for his beloved.
example.traditional: 呢套劇講一個為愛人犧牲嘅戀人。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 gong2 jat1 go3 wai6 oi3 jan4 hei1 sang1 ge3 lyun5 jan4

rows.note: Use this for someone enthusiastic about a hobby, product, or subject rather than a romantic partner.

example.english: They are a photography lover who often goes out to take photos on holidays.
example.traditional: 佢係攝影愛好者，假日成日出去影相。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 sip3 jing2 oi3 hou3 ze2 gaa3 jat6 seng4 jat6 ceot1 heoi3 jing2 soeng2
